History:
59-year-old woman with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed in 2023, seen to discuss escalation of therapy. Past medical history: type 2 diabetes, seasonal allergies.

Exam:
Synovitis of the MCP and PIP joints of both hands; no rheumatoid nodules.

Treatment history:
